issue.title: test_open_action_opens_overlay_on_stash_with_trash_count pins the old 20-row trash limit after 919ba740e raised it to 100

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
Confirmed true failure, not a flake. On master c78eb3805, tests/ace/tui/actions/test_prompts_overlay_entry_points.py::test_open_action_opens_overlay_on_stash_with_trash_count fails deterministically in isolation at line 117: `assert modal._trash_limit == 20` gets 100.

Root cause: 919ba740e6 ("prompts overlay split-button stash tab with trash view, @@ pop-newest, and 100-row trash", agent bbugyi200.apollo.28, no bead) raised PromptsModal's default trash_limit to 100 (src/sase/ace/tui/modals/prompts_modal.py:128). This test still pins the old 20. Fix: update the assertion to the new default, or better, assert against the constant the open action passes, so the test tracks the product default. Check that the open action's trash-count wording still matches the 100-row limit.

Proposed as a clean-base failure by sase-1b2.19 note #4 (epic sase-1b2). Filed by sase-1b2.land.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1b2.19 as a clean-base failure; the sase-1b2 landing confirmed it still fails deterministically on master and no task tracked it.
